name: 46642-solodecode-30ba3bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One in-process engine, the whole model on one card.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder in block-quantised FP8; 30.5B parameters total, 3.3B active per token, ~31 GB on disk.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 100 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed static 46642.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 128 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0 (greedy).
purpose: A single-user long-form drafting assistant on one H100, turning short prompts into thousand-token replies one stream at a time.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Source checkout of e53a17232c3114ab276d7004edb195304ecdad57
# (`git describe` v0.23.1rc0-448-ge53a17232c31), on 1x H100 80GB HBM3.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8

# One GPU, no sharding of any kind.
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned rather than left at `auto`, so the expert backend does not depend on what the installed
# FlashInfer build reports it can do.
moe-backend: triton

# 128 prompt + 1024 output = 1152 tokens per request; 2048 clears it with room.
max-model-len: 2048

# vLLM's own default, written out so a change of default cannot move the cache size.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
